//: Typecheck config for the capture GUI. HAND-WRITTEN AND COMMITTED.
`ags types -u` writes its OWN `tsconfig.json` into this directory and
OVERWRITES it on every run, so that file is gitignored and is NOT what the
typecheck reads. This file deliberately uses a non-colliding name so the
settings below survive regeneration. `make capture-typecheck` passes it
Why this gate exists at all: `ags bundle` TRANSPILES WITHOUT TYPE CHECKING.
Verified — `const bad: number = "string"` bundles with exit 0. So without
this, a wrong signature reaches production silently. See design.md §1.1.
Everything under @girs/, env.d.ts and node_modules/ is GENERATED by
`ags types` (168 files, ~49 MB of machine-specific GTK/Astal declarations)
and is gitignored — see .gitignore. Regenerate with `make capture-types`.
